assumptions: 'Unless otherwise directed by a police officer or traffic control signal' cannot be seen by the camera and is excluded; all vehicles are checked as if no such direction exists.
Stopping is interpreted as remaining continuously inside stop_zone while stopped.
A minimum stopped dwell of 1000 ms is assumed because the statute states no duration.
The stop must occur before the first inbound crossing of stop_line; vehicles that never cross pass vacuously.
Inbound approach (+y from y<0.6 to y>0.6) is encoded as direction to_right per the line definition.
No maximum time gap is imposed between the stop and the crossing.
Anchor center is used because boxes are top-down with centre as metric position while bottom_center is defined as downstream AABB edge, not wheels.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every vehicle that crosses the stop line inbound must have first stopped inside the approach waiting zone.

provenance.reason: Boxes are top-down with centre as metric position; bottom_center is defined as downstream AABB edge, not wheels, so centre is the intended test point.

provenance.quote: stop at the near side of the intersection at a clearly marked stop line

provenance.reason: Statute says 'shall stop' with no duration; 1000 ms continuous stopped dwell is assumed as minimal observable complete stop.
Statute only says 'approaching'; inbound (+y) crossing is encoded as to_right per line definition (moving downwards (+y) = to_right).
Statute imposes no maximum interval between stop and crossing, so no time limit is set.

text: Unless otherwise directed by a police officer or traffic control signal, the driver of a vehicle approaching a stop sign at an intersection shall stop at the near side of the intersection at a clearly marked stop line.
